Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the recap. A few clarifying questions from procurement so we can move to vendor onboarding:

1) Payment method: We prefer to pay by PO (Net 30). Is that supported? If not, can we pay by card or ACH?
2) Invoice fields: We need the company legal name, billing address, remit-to address, and Tax ID/VAT number on invoice. Can you provide an invoice example with those fields populated?
3) Vendor forms: We’ll need a W-9 (US entity) and any vendor registration link for our portal.
4) Marketplace: We are evaluating whether to purchase via AWS Marketplace (so spend shows on our cloud invoice). Do you support marketplace listings and consolidated billing?

If you can send the W-9 and a populated invoice sample that would speed things up. Procurement is copied here — Melissa, I’ll coordinate next steps with you.

Hi all —

Thanks for the notes. Answers below and I’ve attached the requested docs (W-9 + populated invoice sample).

1) Payment methods:
- We support PO (Net 30) for customers on an approved credit profile. For initial PO-based setups we require a signed purchase order and completion of our vendor onboarding form.
- Card/ACH are also supported for self-serve customers; card payments are immediate and don’t require vendor onboarding.

2) Invoice fields (attached sample):
- Legal name: Redwood Inference, LLC
- Tax ID / EIN: 12-3456789
- Billing address (remit-to): Redwood Inference, LLC
  120 Market St, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94105
- Invoice should be sent to accounts.payable@redwoodinference.com and reference your PO number and our invoice number.

3) Vendor forms: Attached: Redwood-W9.pdf. For larger enterprise deals we also provide a vendor onboarding link (https://vendor-onboard.redwoodinference.com/finservco) to collect purchase order and banking details.

4) Marketplace: We are currently listed on AWS Marketplace and can support procurement via AWS consolidated billing. If you choose AWS Marketplace, pricing/discounts may differ slightly and the contract will be handled through the marketplace listing. Let me know if you want an AWS Marketplace quote and I’ll pull it.

5) Net terms: Net 30 is our standard for PO-based billing. For Net 45/60 or longer we route to finance for credit review.

Attachments: Redwood-W9.pdf, Redwood-Invoice-Sample-FinServCo.pdf

If procurement can send the vendor form and PO to billing@redwoodinference.com we’ll turn the invoice around same business day after vendor setup.

—
Dev Patel
Billing & Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
